headline: Morey School donation, Apple purchase motion, HVAC status, and school bus cameras are on the agenda.
summary: Other items include a response on the payroll schedule and on exploring a centralized location for district offices, equipment, and storage. The agenda also lists grant and summary reports, plus requests for travel to Providence, RI and a state conference in Chatham, MA.
items: Spotlight on the community school model in LPS
Memorial for Sharon Fennelly, retired Lincoln Elementary assistant principal
Motion by Dominik Lay asking for Apple emails, correspondence, and purchase details, including the $50 discount and its deadline
Response to motions on payroll schedule outlines
Response to motion on exploring a centralized location, including admin offices, equipment, and storage
Response to motion on possibly moving 4th and 5th floor admin offices
Response to motion on a camera program on selected school buses
Quarterly grants update, 4th quarter July 1 to June 30, 2026 (FY26 Q4)
Request to accept donation letter for Morey School
Out-of-state travel request, Lowell High School to Providence, RI
Overnight request to state conference in Chatham, MA
United Teachers of Lowell donating fourteen sick leave days to Taylor Leduc, Lowell High School teacher
location: City Council Chamber, 375 Merrimack Street, 2nd Floor, Lowell, MA 01852

Regular Meeting Agenda
